search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-07-17 inclusive. Included only dated entries and passages describing information published by that cutoff; no outcome, odds, betting pages, or post-cutoff developments are included. Search results supplied publication dates and source text. web_fetch failed because multiple providers were registered; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback returned RATE_LIMITED, so full-page retrieval could not be completed. The Arena changelog item refers only to its explicitly dated July 16 entry. Some announcement pages are maintained and contain later edits; those edits were excluded, but an archived pre-cutoff version was not retrieved. The July 16 secondary leaderboard snapshot does not explicitly establish style control off, official Rank values, or granular tie-breaking scores, so it is contextual evidence rather than a verified exact-resolution snapshot. A style-controlled, company-deduplicated ranking was excluded because it does not match the resolution method. No forecast or resolution conclusion is asserted.
